title: Blueshift International Materials
content: Blueshift International Materials develops and manufactures polyimide aerogel materials under the brand AeroZero, producing ultra-thin, flexible aerogel films for aerospace, defense, and advanced electronics applications. Their technology enables aerogels in thin-film form factors not achievable with traditional silica aerogels. The company was founded based on technology developed at NASA.
